test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Pass the baton

options.text: pass on belongings to the heirs
take part in a relay race

solution:
The correct answer is "**shift responsibility to others.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the pass the baton is to **shift responsibility to others**.
 
• The idiom means a collection of words that have been proven by usage to have a meaning apart from the meanings of the individual terms.
